content: Evolution API /message/sendMedia takes number, mediatype (image|video|document), mimetype, caption, media, fileName, delay, linkPreview, mentioned, quoted. 'media' accepts an HTTP(S) URL, local path, raw base64 or data-URI. When given a URL the EVOLUTION HOST fetches it server-side, so the URL must be publicly reachable from the Evolution container - localhost/LAN/192.168.x URLs and short-lived signed URLs fail there. WhatsApp itself caps media at ~16MB for image/video/audio sent as media (documents much larger). Oversized/odd-codec video shows up as GH issues like #2056 'image fails to load on mobile app'. mimetype must match the actual bytes or clients render a broken attachment.
